newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OUT expects more favourable 1997 profits.
newsitem.headline: OUT expects more favourable 1997 profits.

text.p: Overseas Union Trust Ltd, a unit of the Overseas Union Bank Ltd, said on Friday it expected more favourable 1997 earnings than last year.

In a statement accompanying its earnings for the six months ended June 30, 1997, it said this was despite a tougher environment in the second half posted by slower loan demand and firming interest rates.

"Nevertheless, the company remains confident that, barring any unforeseen ciurcumstances, the results for the full year for the company and the group will be more favourable than those of the previous year," it said.
The group's net profit for the first six months of 1997 rose 58.6 percent to Singapore $10.88 million.
